method: Direct visual inspection of the two supplied encoded PNG frames only. Native OCR status is unchanged.

findings.observation: The frame clearly shows AM I in white textured block letters at left-center. I is a separate upright glyph with visible spacing after AM; it is fully within the picture and unobscured.

The frame clearly shows HIS BROTHER'S NAME WAS above a large red JUBAL;. J, U, B, A and L are all legible, followed by a separate semicolon with an upper dot and lower comma form. No extra letter I is visible.
